verdict.rationale: uv is a CLI tool whose only 'API' is its command-line interface, which is thoroughly documented (uv-probe-4 CLI reference) and includes some machine-friendly outputs (e.g. `uv version --output-format json`) plus a claimed llms.txt/markdown doc mirror for LLM consumption (uv-docs-52). However there is no true public REST/SDK API, and independent probes found no openapi spec and a 404 on the root llms.txt path (uv-probe-1, uv-probe-3), so AI-native programmatic access is limited to shelling out to the CLI rather than calling a documented API surface. Missing for 10: a genuine REST/SDK API, confirmed working llms.txt/openapi endpoint, and evidence of agents driving uv via anything beyond CLI invocation.
